claims.text: The current Dayline pack capacity is 18 liters.

evidence.quote: The fictional Dayline pack has an 18-liter capacity and weighs 540 grams.
evidence.suppliedPassage: The fictional Dayline pack has an 18-liter capacity and weighs 540 grams. It has adjustable shoulder straps, one main compartment and a sleeve for laptops up to 13 inches. It is intended for city commutes and short day walks. Available colors are Moss and Sand.

records.notes: Current 75 post-discount threshold is correct and supported, but expected explanation that archived 60 threshold expired is omitted.

claims.text: The current free-shipping threshold is 75 demo USD: standard shipping is free when the merchandise subtotal after discounts is at least 75 demo USD; otherwise it costs 6 demo USD per order.

evidence.quote: Standard shipping costs 6 demo USD per order, and is free when the merchandise subtotal after discounts is at least 75 demo USD.
evidence.suppliedPassage: This fictional store ships only to the contiguous United States. Standard delivery takes 5 to 7 business days after dispatch. Standard shipping costs 6 demo USD per order, and is free when the merchandise subtotal after discounts is at least 75 demo USD. Taxes are not specified. No express shipping or international delivery is offered.

claims.text: A post-discount merchandise subtotal exactly equal to 75 demo USD qualifies, and shipping charges do not count toward the threshold.

evidence.quote: A post-discount merchandise subtotal exactly equal to 75 demo USD qualifies for free standard shipping. Shipping charges themselves do not count toward the merchandise threshold.
evidence.suppliedPassage: A post-discount merchandise subtotal exactly equal to 75 demo USD qualifies for free standard shipping. Shipping charges themselves do not count toward the merchandise threshold.
